ranked_hypotheses.title: Laplace-Harmonic Gravity-Vector Divergence (Band 18, Band 11), Depth-Invariant Magnetic Tilt Zero-Crossing Wall, Multi-Scale Piedmont-Horst Bedrock Contact Spine & PU-Safe 89-Ch/76-Ch Dual-Cover Hydrothermal-Vent OOF with 3-Zone Radial Bi-Population Transfer & Axial-Crest CELF
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature_and_transform: Computes exact horizontal divergence div(g_H) = d(Band 18)/dx + d(Band 11)/dy = -d^2g/dz^2 via Laplace's equation in the source-free upper half-space (Blakely 1995) and the Blakely-Simpson (1986) cross-contact inflection crest along the unit gravity gradient vector n_g = (Band 18, Band 11)/||g_H||, gated by basement throw ||grad(Band 15)||. Combines with Miller & Singh (1994) magnetic tilt-angle zero-crossing walls on Band 6/3/9, multi-scale Hessian bedrock/piedmont ridges on Band 12/19, transtensional accommodation bridges (Bands 4,7,8,10,16), and MT clay-cap lateral edges (Band 17) + 4-block standardized 214Bi radon + GDR #1391 thermal vents. Trains an 89-ch/76-ch Dual-Cover OOF classifier fused with a 3-zone radial bi-population transfer function and axial-spaced submodular CELF (K=37,654, B=2.0 px, min_sep_px=3.22).
ranked_hypotheses.why_catches_missing_faults: Directly resolves three distinct classes of unmapped faults missed by surface-scarp detectors: (1) buried intrabasin horst-bounding faults beneath 50-400 m of quaternary fill via Laplace-harmonic gravity divergence and magnetic tilt zero-crossings; (2) blind transtensional step-overs and accommodation zones (600 m - 2.2 km from mapped faults) where 75% of Great Basin geothermal systems occur (Faulds et al. 2011); and (3) far-field (>1.5 km) range-front piedmont and bedrock faults including inside the 24.63% 1 m LiDAR gap.
named_non_fault_mimics: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan wave-cut shorelines (~1,330 m Sehoo and ~1,235 m Fallon highstands)
US Census TIGER/Line highway/railroad embankments and irrigation canal prisms
4-contractor GeoDAWN airborne radiometric survey seam steps (Blocks A, B, C, E)
Deep flat playa/evaporite depocenters (depth_to_base > 320 m, slope < 1.6 deg) with non-tectonic saline MT conductivity
ranked_hypotheses.differs_from_existing_repo: First pipeline in the GEMSDOE registry to exploit the native pre-computed horizontal gravity gradient vector (Band 18, Band 11) via Laplace's equation div(g_H) = -d^2g/dz^2, and the first to pair an 89-ch/76-ch Dual-Cover OOF classifier with a 3-zone radial bi-population transfer function and axial d=3.22 px CELF that beats the 0.2778 Champion on Hide-and-Recover, Detached >=600m, AND Off-Catalogue SGMC simultaneously while remaining <=70% overlap against all 495 genuine discrete rasters.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_gain_vs_cost: Expected +0.0025 to +0.0070 HOLDOUT-DTI across both Hide-and-Recover and Off-Catalogue SGMC benchmarks; runtime ~410 s on CPU (<4.2 GB RSS).

ranked_hypotheses.title: Coaxial Geodetic Shear-Dilatation & Relocated Microseismic Accommodation Bridge Tensor
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature_and_transform: Constructs the coaxial transtensional strain rate invariant T_strain = z+(Band 4) * z+(Band 8) * sigmoid(z+(Band 7)) coupled with the relocated-to-catalogue microseismic clustering ratio R_eq = z+(Band 16) - 0.35*z+(Band 10), projected along structural strike ridges between en-echelon fault tips.
ranked_hypotheses.why_catches_missing_faults: Horsetail splay relays, overlapping step-overs, and accommodation zones fragment surface rupture across multiple small sub-resolution fractures that lack a single continuous LiDAR scarp, but concentrate active transtensional shear strain and relocated microseismic swarms.
named_non_fault_mimics: Long-wavelength GPS station interpolation halos (~15-30 km)
Anthropogenic geothermal injection seismicity clusters at Dixie Valley / Brady / Desert Peak
ranked_hypotheses.differs_from_existing_repo: Replaces isotropic earthquake density smoothing with the relocated-vs-raw seismic clustering contrast gated by structural strike coherence and geodetic shear*dilatation.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_gain_vs_cost: Highest single-feature holdout AUC (0.565243) among the 6 new BHGC channels; +0.0015 HOLDOUT-DTI on Detached >= 600 m segments.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Magnetotelluric Smectite-Illite Clay-Cap Lateral Edge, Hydrothermal Demagnetization Low & 4-Block Standardized 214Bi Radon / GDR #1391 Vent Conduit
exact_layers: DOE GDR #1391 thermal wells/springs & sinter/travertine vents (10.15121/1881483)
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature_and_transform: Computes the lateral spatial gradient ||grad_H log(1 + Band 17)||_2 of surface MT electrical conductivity to isolate the steeply dipping fault boundary of conductive smectite-illite hydrothermal clay caps, multiplied by 4-block contractor-standardized 214Bi/208Tl radon soil-gas enrichment, magnetite-to-pyrite hydrothermal demagnetization lows (-z(Band 2)*z+(Band 14)), and GDR #1391 thermal/sinter proximity.
ranked_hypotheses.why_catches_missing_faults: Hydrothermal alteration converts competent fault-scarp bedrock into soft argillic clay (smectite/illite/chlorite), erasing topographic relief while creating a sharp lateral MT conductivity boundary, a magnetic destruction trough, and an active 222Rn -> 214Bi gas degassing chimney.
named_non_fault_mimics: Saline evaporite playas in the Carson Sink and Humboldt Sink (high Band 17 conductivity and evaporite K/U in flat basins)
Airborne gamma-ray contractor block boundaries (Blocks A, B, C, E)
ranked_hypotheses.differs_from_existing_repo: Uses lateral gradient ||grad_H(Band 17)||_2 rather than raw conductivity magnitude and applies strict playa suppression (depth > 320 m, slope < 1.6 deg) plus 4-block radiometric seam de-confounding.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_gain_vs_cost: Single-feature holdout AUC = 0.545390; +0.0012 HOLDOUT-DTI on hydrothermally altered blind fault segments.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Anisotropic Wavelet Phase-Congruency & Curvature Tensor Across Multi-Azimuth Topographic & Potential-Field Envelopes
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature_and_transform: Computes Kovesi log-Gabor multi-orientation phase congruency across 6 azimuths to extract amplitude-invariant step/ridge phase alignments across gravity, magnetic, and detrended elevation fields.
ranked_hypotheses.why_catches_missing_faults: Detects subtle low-amplitude flexural scarps and antithetic intrabasin graben steps whose absolute relief is < 0.5 m.
named_non_fault_mimics: Eolian sand dune trains and braided alluvial distributor channels
100 m DEM grid resampling moire artifacts
ranked_hypotheses.differs_from_existing_repo: Amplitude-invariant frequency-domain phase congruency rather than spatial Gaussian second derivatives.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_gain_vs_cost: Expected +0.0008 HOLDOUT-DTI, high FFT compute cost (~25 min across 6 scales x 6 orientations); deferred per 3-experiment budget rule.

planned_experiments.description: Purely label-free 6-channel BHGC physical structural-geothermal spine + visible-fault tip continuation relay (zero supervised OOF classifier), emitted with axial spacing d=3.22 px, B=2.0 px, K=37,654.

89-channel M_Full + 76-channel LiDAR-free M_Sub Dual-Cover HistGradientBoosting OOF ensemble with visible-tip relay only (w_far_spine = 0.0, no 3-zone radial modulation), emitted with d=3.22 px, B=2.0 px, K=37,654.

Full H-APART-1 (BHGC-3) 3-zone radial bi-population transfer function coupling Zone-1 LLI collar depletion (2.0 < d_vis <= 5.5 px), Zone-2 detached-segment & transtensional accommodation amplification (5.2 < d_vis <= 22.0 px), and Zone-3 far-field Laplace-harmonic gravity/magnetic/piedmont-horst spine floor (d_vis > 21.8 px), emitted via axial-spaced submodular CELF (d=3.22 px, B=2.0 px, K=37,654).
